description: Local page and file counter for document collections

script: if ($global) { throw 'FileTally supports per-user Scoop installation only.' }
if (-not [Environment]::Is64BitOperatingSystem -or [Environment]::OSVersion.Version.Major -lt 10) { throw 'FileTally requires 64-bit Windows 10 or later.' }
# NSIS retains its unnamed installation-directory preference after uninstall.

if ($remembered.GetValueKind('') -ne [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::String -or $remembered.GetValue('', $null, [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueOptions]::DoNotExpandEnvironmentNames) -ne $installDir) { throw 'FileTally remembers an unknown installation location. No files were changed.' }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $registration) { throw 'FileTally is already installed. This package will not adopt or update an existing direct installation.' }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $installDir) { throw 'The FileTally installation folder already exists. No files were changed.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "FileTally installer exited with code $($process.ExitCode)." }
if ($installed.InstallLocation.Trim('"') -ne $installDir) { throw 'The installer did not register the expected per-user location.' }

if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $appFile -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '595cf9e598a07220ece01a2feb9471e4082e6c4f96c90b72f6b209a7c84cbd76') { throw 'The installed app does not match the accepted release.' }

@{ app = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $appFile -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; uninstaller = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $uninstaller -Algorithm SHA256).Hash } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress | Set-Content -LiteralPath $receipt -Encoding Ascii

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $receipt) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $registration)) { throw 'This package does not own the existing FileTally installation. Use its original installation channel.' }
if ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $installDir -Force).Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { throw 'A linked installation folder cannot be managed by this package.' }
if ($installed.InstallLocation.Trim('"') -ne $installDir) { throw 'FileTally installation location changed; package operation stopped.' }

if ($proof.app -ne (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $appFile -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -or $proof.uninstaller -ne (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $uninstaller -Algorithm SHA256).Hash) { throw 'FileTally changed outside this package. No files were removed.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "FileTally uninstaller exited with code $($process.ExitCode)." }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $registration) { throw 'FileTally uninstall registration remains; the ownership receipt was preserved.' }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $appFile) { throw 'FileTally app remains; the ownership receipt was preserved.' }

notes: Seven-day full-feature trial, then a one-time license. See https://filetally.com/licensing.
Runs the signed per-user NSIS installer; this is not a portable build.
Use one installation channel. Existing direct installations are never adopted.
Uninstall preserves licenses, trial history and saved scans.
